title: hieracium triangulare
intro: Hieracium triangulare, commonly known as Devil's-bit scabious, is a flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a perennial herb native to Europe and Asia, known for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and respiratory problems, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and expectorant effects. The bioactive constituents of Devil's-bit scabious include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its health benefits and medicinal properties.
